parts: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
rows.text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
rows.text_tl: Ang Panginoon ay malapit sa kanila na may bagbag na puso, at inililigtas ang mga may pagsisising diwa.

parts: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
rows.text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
rows.text_tl: Huwag kang matakot, sapagka't ako'y sumasaiyo; huwag kang manglupaypay, sapagka't ako'y iyong Dios; aking palalakasin ka; oo, aking tutulungan ka; oo, aking aalalayan ka ng kanang kamay ng aking katuwiran.

parts: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
rows.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
rows.text_tl: Na inyong ilagak sa kaniya ang lahat ng inyong kabalisahan, sapagka't kayo'y ipinagmamalasakit niya.

parts: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
rows.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
rows.text_tl: Sa lahat ng mga bagay ay magpasalamat kayo; sapagka't ito ang kalooban ng Dios kay Cristo tungkol sa inyo.

parts: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
rows.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
rows.text_tl: Purihin mo ang Panginoon, Oh kaluluwa ko, at huwag mong kalimutan ang lahat niyang mabubuting gawa.

parts: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
rows.text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
rows.text_tl: Ito ang araw na ginawa ng Panginoon; tayo'y mangagagalak at ating katutuwaan.
